channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não planeja dar um cargo ao pai se for eleito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated he does not intend to appoint his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to a government position if elected, though he has not ruled out the possibility entirely. The statement was made during a press conference where he discussed his presidential campaign.

item.title: 51% são contra reeleição e 46% defendem mais de um mandato; diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows that 51% of voters oppose reelection for presidents and governors, while 46% support more than one term. The issue gains prominence after Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) stance against reelection, with stronger support for the current model among PT voters and opposition among PL voters.

item.title: “Pega esse dedo e enfia no coração”, diz Janja a crítico em MG
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva responded to a critic during Lula's campaign rally in Ipatinga, MG, saying 'Grab that finger and stick it in your heart.' Lula warned that right-wing policies would be at risk if the opposition returns to power.

item.title: Redução de palanques locais no segundo turno desafia os presidenciáveis
item.description: On October 4th, 21 states concluded their local races in the second round, leaving only six with active contests, increasing complexity for the presidential campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The states still holding elections represent 7.9% of the electorate and could sway the national outcome.

item.title: Ação do PT contra lei de terras executada por Tarcísio é retomada no STF
item.description: The STF resumed the hearing of the PT's lawsuit challenging São Paulo's land regularization law, originally enacted in 2022 and repurposed by Tarcísio de Freitas. Minister Cármen Lúcia maintained her vote declaring the law unconstitutional, while Justice Gilmar Mendes partially dissented, upholding its constitutionality. The PT criticizes the law for allowing up to 90% discounts on public land sales, changing their intended use.

item.title: Às vésperas do segundo turno, Lula parte para o ‘tudo ou nada’ com pacote de ações eleitoreiras
item.description: Ahead of the runoff, Lula launches an R$17 billion package for self-employed workers, including tax debt forgiveness and a R$5,000 aid payment via Pix, targeting 17 million informal workers. The measure, with clear electoral bias, aims to attract dissatisfied voters and expand his support base, despite polls showing a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Defesa de Dark Horse promete perícia após eleição e prevê disputa por Oscar
item.description: The defense of production company GoUp confirmed it will conduct a new audit of Dark Horse film finances only after the elections, rejecting probes questioning the legality of funding. Lawyer Ricardo Sayeg stated confidence that the film will compete for an Oscar and that the audit will reveal the legitimacy of fundraising. The case involves allegations of $12.3 million sent to a US fund and contradictions about the money's origins.

item.title: Timing desastroso da Globo com Flávio abre crise com Lula
item.description: The meeting between Globo's leadership and Flávio Bolsonaro drew criticism from Lula, who labeled the encounter suspicious and hinted at retaliation against his government's policies. The PT bench deemed the timing politically damaging for the broadcaster, especially after Lula avoided direct comments about journalist Renata Lo Prete. The incident revives tensions between the press and the executive branch, focusing on regulatory issues such as the 6x1 workday and betting regulations.

item.title: Covid fica fora do top 10 de causas de morte pelo 3º ano em 2025
item.description: Covid-19 has been out of the top 10 leading causes of death in Brazil for the third consecutive year in 2025, with only 1,664 deaths — a 99.6% drop from the 2021 peak. By October 2026, mild and moderate cases fell by 67.2%, and deaths linked to the disease decreased by 65.8%.

item.title: Mais de 4,3 mil seções eleitorais mudaram de local para o 2º turno; veja como consultar onde votar
item.description: Over 4,300 polling stations had their voting location changed for the 2026 general election runoff, mainly due to heavy rains, last-minute renovations, and accessibility issues. Voters are advised to confirm their new address via the e-Título app or the TSE’s online self-service portal. The changes do not reduce the total number of stations and mostly affect São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Bahia.

item.title: TSE nega pedido de Flávio para proibir gravações de Lula no Alvorada
item.description: The TSE rejected a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to prohibit President Lula from recording electoral content at the official palaces. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva deemed the request generic and overly restrictive to political communication.

item.title: Flávio usa sabatina como propaganda, enaltece bolsonarismo e deixa conta do ajuste em aberto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro turned his Globo interview into campaign propaganda, evading answers on justice for January 8 coup supporters and praising Bolsonarism. He left fiscal accounts open, linking solutions to anti-corruption efforts and AI.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula advocates for democracy in a speech, highlighting the importance of dialogue despite disagreements. The statement reflects the current political climate and the country's polarization. The topic is addressed in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usa "golpe da Disney" e foge das perguntas sobre a família
item.description: In a live interview on Jornal Nacional, Flávio Bolsonaro avoided directly answering questions about his father Jair Bolsonaro's potential conviction, using disputed claims like 'the trial was a farce' and deflecting from the topic. He defended his family, downplaying his father's role on January 8 and attacking opposing judges and politicians, while addressing issues like security and economy only briefly. The interview was characterized by evasive responses and controversial rhetoric.

item.title: IA de Elon Musk recusa pedidos sobre Lula e atende os de Flávio
item.description: Poder360 tested seven AI tools to create electoral artwork for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro; Grok only fulfilled the request for Flávio, while Meta AI, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude served both. The investigation follows a TSE order imposing equal treatment for both candidates under a $100,000 fine, after allegations of favoritism by Meta.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Datafolha sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula na eleição presidencial
item.description: Datafolha will release on Thursday (22) a new survey on the 2026 presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, keeping the technical tie between candidates. Beyond voting intentions, the poll will analyze candidate rejection rates, Lula’s government approval, and perceptions of the economy, next president’s priorities, and relations with the US and China.

item.title: Segurança, escala 6×1 e Milei: os temas de Lula para o debate contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula prepares for the second round debate against Flávio Bolsonaro focusing on public security, reduction of criminal responsibility age, and ties with international far-right. The PT campaign highlights proposals like the 6×1 workday reduction and criticizes Eduardo Bolsonaro's interactions with U.S. authorities.

item.title: A condição de Michelle para viajar com Flávio na campanha do 2º turno
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, elected senator from the Federal District, set a condition to travel with her nephew Flávio Bolsonaro during the 2nd round only if she can return the same day, to avoid being away from her husband, who is under house arrest in Brasília. Flávio's campaign aims to have her join events to reduce his rejection among female voters in the Northeast. In the first round, they did not hold any joint street events, with Michelle focused on her Senate campaign.

item.title: Veja as palavras mais faladas por Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula nas sabatinas à TV Globo
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participated in TV Globo interviews, with word frequency analyses showing Lula emphasizing 'Brasil', 'People', and 'Economy', while Flávio focused on 'Brasil', 'Government', and 'Lula'. Both discussed topics such as economy, security, and governance.

item.title: O que a eleição de uma estreante deputada federal de 24 anos do Rio revela sobre a onda de direita no Brasil
item.description: The election of 24-year-old influencer Julia de Castro from Rio de Janeiro reflects the rise of young right-wing figures who leverage digital political capital and are recruited by parties like the PL, reinforcing a conservative wave in Brazil.

item.title: Pergunta de milhões de dólares
item.description: The 'Dollar Question' poll shows 74% of 908 respondents believe the issue is 'turning', while 26% say 'not even standing tall'. The content features political analysis on figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, Ricardo Noblat, and topics such as criminal responsibility, security, and the 2026 elections.

item.title: Damares pede investigação de uso de van com marca do MEC em compromisso de campanha de Lula
item.description: Senator Damares Alves requested the Electoral Public Ministry to investigate the use of a van bearing the Ministry of Education's branding to transport students who recorded a video supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign, questioning the legality of using a federal agency's image in political activity.

item.title: Flávio absorve 3 erros de Lula; petista volta a ser ‘metamorfose’ e usa a máquina no vale-tudo final
item.description: In the final stretch of the presidential race, Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula da Silva repeated similar mistakes: arrogance, self-sufficiency, and repetitive speech patterns. Lula corrected his campaign post-first round, while Flávio adopted the same errors, focusing on defending Jair Bolsonaro and neglecting key issues like security and economy.

item.title: Empenho na campanha de Flávio cacifa Nunes para tentar suceder Tarcísio no governo de SP
item.description: Ricardo Nunes, mayor of São Paulo, actively supported Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign by lending staff and organizing mobilizations, which allies and critics view as positioning himself as successor to Tarcísio for the 2030 São Paulo governorship. Nunes denied discussing succession with the senator, while campaign figures emphasize his central role.

item.title: Nikolas orienta 3 passos para reta final da campanha de Flávio e alerta: ‘Não subestimem o Lula’
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira advised Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign with three final steps, warning not to underestimate Lula. He emphasized avoiding unproductive debates, mastering the government plan, and engaging in everyday conversations about cost of living and security. Nikolas will campaign in the Northeast, including an event in Salvador with Flávio.

item.title: Marco Civil da Internet x Digital Services Act: dois caminhos regulatórios
item.description: The Decree 12.975/2026 updates the Marco Civil da Internet based on the STF ruling, introducing a systemic duty of care for digital platforms, especially regarding serious illegal content, while maintaining judicial oversight for free speech-sensitive issues. Comparing it with the EU’s Digital Services Act (DSA) reveals similarities, such as graduated responsibilities based on platform size and risks, though the DSA mandates independent audits and risk mitigation for Very Large Online Platforms.

item.title: O conselho de Motta a Lula para o 2º turno das eleições
item.description: Hugo Motta, Chamber President, advised Lula for the 2026 second round, emphasizing mobilizing Northeast voters and adopting a centrist speech in the South and Southeast. The warning includes risks of voter demobilization and lack of electoral competition in several Northeastern states.

item.title: Estado 'espelho' do Brasil, MG entra no foco das campanhas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro para o 2º turno
item.description: Minas Gerais, the second-largest electoral college in Brazil and considered a 'mirror' of national elections, has become the focus of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) campaigns for the runoff. While Lula seeks to reverse his small deficit in the state, Flávio aims to expand the advantage he held in the first round. MG's relevance stems from its electoral weight and its historical tendency to mirror the national vote since 1989.

item.title: Abstenção cai entre jovens, idosos e menos instruídos no 1º turno, segundo TSE
item.description: Voter abstention in the 2026 first-round election decreased among young people up to 18, the elderly, and less educated voters, according to TSE data. This trend contradicts the overall pattern of increased abstention compared to 2022.

item.title: Debate da Band entre Lula e Flávio terá confronto livre de 30 minutos; veja regras
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will face each other in 30 minutes of direct confrontation in the first block of the Band debate, scheduled for Sunday (the 18th), in São Paulo. The rules were agreed upon by the broadcaster and party representatives.

item.title: Pulverização de atos pró-Lula causa divisão e temor de embate com bolsonaristas
item.description: Pro-Lula rallies scheduled for Sunday (18) faced venue changes, causing internal divisions among supporters and fears of clashes with Bolsonarists. Political polarization intensifies ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Borges: Flávio e Lula não fizeram nem golaços, nem gols contra na Globo
item.description: Alexandre Borges assessed that the sabatina interviews of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula on Globo did not have 'any disaster', ending without 'either a home run or an own goal'. The analysis was made during a coverage presented by Natália Mota.

item.title: Na Globo, Flávio erra sobre 'Dark Horse' e ao citar documentário de Lula
item.description: In a Globo interview, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) made factual errors claiming the 'Dark Horse' producer had accounted for all costs and that Federal Police confirmed a R$30 million payment to a Lula documentary by Vorcaro. His statements, lacking immediate factual backing, sparked criticism for spreading misinformation during the campaign.

item.title: Casado: Flávio se diferenciou do pai, mas deixou perguntas sem resposta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro distinguished himself from his father by adopting a more moderate stance during a Globo interview, but repeated campaign points and avoided direct answers. Letícia Casado noted the candidate made accusations without providing concrete responses, leaving questions unanswered.

item.title: TV Cultura transmite debate entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula neste domingo (18)
item.description: On Sunday (October 18), TV Cultura broadcasts at 8 PM the first direct electoral debate between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), live at Band's studios, with pre-debate coverage starting at 7:30 PM featuring 'De Olho no Voto' and post-debate analysis at 10 PM. The debate will be pooled by five media outlets including Band, Estadão, Gazeta, and Jovem Pan, along with radio broadcasts on Cultura Brasil (77.9 FM) and Cultura FM (103.3 FM).

item.title: Em sabatina, Flávio não explica propostas e faz acusações sem provas
item.description: In a TV Globo interview, Flávio Bolsonaro avoided detailing policy proposals and downplayed the January 8th events, calling them a farce. He denied a coup attempt and defended donation requests without clearly explaining his stance on economy, education, and security.

item.title: “O cara tá afiado”: aliados elogiam Flávio após entrevista à “Globo”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies celebrated his performance in the TV Globo interview, praising his calm demeanor and assertive answers. The interview took place nine days before the runoff election on October 25, where he will face Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Lawmakers and commentators commended Flávio, particularly on public security, while criticizing interviewer Renata Lo Prete.

item.title: “Motoboy”: Flávio repete estratégia de Bolsonaro e usa cola na mão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) replicated his father's strategy by writing 'motoboy' on his hand during a TV Globo interview. The gesture referenced a meeting with delivery workers, a category he promised to support. He had previously used similar tactics in past campaigns.

item.title: Centrão tenta chegar a acordo para votar novo sistema eleitoral e conter avanço da direita
item.description: Center-right parties in Brazil are discussing electoral reform to curb the growth of the PL, which elected 112 deputies. Proposed models include a mixed district system and majoritarian districts, aiming to reduce the advantage of high-vote candidates. The initiative faces resistance from the PL and internal disagreements among allies, complicating electoral reform approval in this legislative term.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: PF aponta divergência ‘severa’ entre recursos enviados ao exterior e os que retornaram ao Brasil para filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police found a severe accounting discrepancy between the $12 million sent abroad and the $2.8 million that returned to Brazil to fund the film 'Dark Horse', a Biographical movie about Jair Bolsonaro. Investigators are probing whether the funds were misappropriated under the guise of the film's production.

item.title: Jovens intensificam mobilização para conquistar votos para Lula e Flávio no segundo turno
item.description: Young people aged 16 to 24 are intensifying mobilizations in support of Lula and Flávio ahead of the runoff, occupying universities and social media to influence undecided voters. They act as message multipliers among peers using strategies such as stickers, protests, and digital content. The goal is to reduce abstention and engage new voters in the decisive phase.

item.title: Mirassol vence o Internacional e se distancia do Z-4
item.description: Mirassol defeated Internacional 2-0 with goals from Eduardo and André Luís in the 31st round of the Brazilian Championship. The victory secured the Lion 36 points, staying clear of relegation, while the Colombian team dropped to 32 points, remaining in the relegation zone. Goalkeeper Matheus Cunha was sent off in the first half, but Mirassol dominated the second half.

item.title: Datafolha: 59% defendem que ministros do STF deveriam ter mandato
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 59% of Brazilians support establishing a fixed term for Supreme Court ministers, replacing lifetime tenure up to age 75. Additionally, 65% favor ending individual ministerial decisions and 52% support reducing the privileged jurisdiction for politicians. These proposals have backing from voters of both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with minor percentage variations.

item.title: Datafolha: Brasil vive polarização política para 78%
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on October 16, 2026, shows that 78% of Brazilians believe the country is experiencing political polarization, with society divided into opposing views. The perception is higher among college-educated voters (93%) and young people aged 16 to 24 (85%). The survey was conducted with 2,520 people in 153 cities between October 13 and 14, 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo: o que disse o candidato à Presidência na 2ª entrevista à emissora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) gave an interview to TV Globo, promising a 'war' on drug trafficking and stating he won't reverse the 6x1 scale. He will face Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round on October 25, holding a slight 2-point lead in voter intention polls.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que 'contrato não foi cumprido' ao responder por que pediu R$ 134 milhões a Vorcaro para filme que custou R$ 75 milhões
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in an interview with TV Globo that a contract related to the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' was not fulfilled, when asked about R$134 million requested from Daniel Vorcaro. The Federal Police are investigating possible money laundering and corruption charges.

item.title: Flávio nega Eduardo como chanceler e diz que Jair não pediu cargo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, never requested a position in a potential government and rejected the possibility of naming his brother Eduardo as foreign minister. In an interview with TV Globo, the senator said the matter was never discussed between them and that he intends to consult his father on political decisions, while maintaining a stance of not offering positions.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai manter o fim da escala 6 X 1 se for eleito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will keep the end of the 6 x 1 workweek if elected, despite initially opposing the constitutional amendment. He justified the shift in stance after hearing widespread worker support for the measure, while pledging to protect labor rights and counteract potential loss of purchasing power. The amendment was approved by the Senate in two voting rounds and enacted in a formal ceremony attended by national leaders.

item.title: Na “Globo”, Flávio cita Huck e Fred Kachar para defender “Dark Horse”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended the funding of 'Dark Horse' during a Globo interview, referencing Banco Master sponsorships involving Frederic Kachar and Luciano Huck. He claimed the funds from Daniel Vorcaro were lawful and unirregular, even as Kachar was fired after leaked conversations emerged. Journalist Renata Lo Prete challenged the comparison, noting differences between commercial sponsorships and film financing.

item.title: A promessa feita por Flávio Bolsonaro sobre o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in a TV interview that he will not push to change the constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 work schedule, adopting the 5×2 format. He justified this based on worker support and emphasized that the decision was made by Congress. Allies may review the proposal starting in 2026.
